title: Constrained Extreme Gradient Boosting for Parametric Proper Orthogonal Decomposition Subspace Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2605.04130v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: High-fidelity simulations such as computational fluid dynamics and finite element analysis are essential for modelling complex engineering systems but remain prohibitively expensive for tasks including parametric studies, optimisation and real-time control. Projection-based reduced-order models (ROMs) alleviate this cost by projecting full-order dynamics onto low-dimensional subspaces. On the other hand, projection-based ROMs can become less robust under parameter variation, and one approach is to adapt the projection basis (that is, the subspace) as the parameters change. tldr: 本文提出约束极端梯度提升方法（cXGBoost），通过将POD子空间从格拉斯曼流形映射到欧几里得空间并施加约束进行训练，从而在参数变化下高效预测降阶模型的投影基。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constrained extreme gradient boosting (cXGBoost), which maps POD subspaces from the Grassmann manifold to a Euclidean space and trains with constraints to efficiently predict projection bases for reduced-order models under parameter variation.
